java_locations.role: With a single requested family, always derives that primary Java AWT Font; any physical-glyph fallback remains AWT Font behavior rather than selecting a different PlantUML family.
Returns the face-aware AWT Font used for the complete text.
Measures that AWT Font with fractional FontMetrics.getStringBounds.
Uses the same resolved font for layout dimensions and descent.

rust_locations.role: Uses exact four-face tables only for printable ASCII and assigns every other scalar 1024 units.
The checked-in derivation currently emits only printable ASCII even though the same AWT API can derive assigned Unicode scalar advances.

claimed_invariant: For text whose AWT width is the sum of scalar advances, every assigned Unicode scalar is measured with the same Times New Roman face and JDK fallback behavior as printable ASCII. Plain, bold, italic, and bold-italic layout widths therefore use the exact face that SVG emission names.
causal_divergence: The previous implementation deliberately replaced every non-ASCII scalar with a half-em advance. Java instead measures the actual Times New Roman glyph or the AWT fallback glyph inside the resolved face. Accented Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, and punctuation consequently receive different advances, which changes state dimensions, Graphviz label boxes, routes, and canvases.

derivation.domain: Every Character.isDefined Unicode scalar in the pinned JDK, excluding surrogate code points, for all four binary faces.
derivation.encoding: Integer 2048-unit advances compressed into maximal consecutive codepoint ranges sharing the same four-face tuple; undefined scalars use a separately extracted missing-glyph tuple.

planned_model_change: Extend the checked-in Java extractor to emit deterministic Rust range data for assigned Unicode scalars and all four Times New Roman faces. Check in the generated range table with generator provenance, binary-search it from times_new_roman_text_width, and replace the half-em non-ASCII branch with the extracted face tuple. Keep printable ASCII in the same generated face model or cross-check the existing arrays against it. Do not add string-specific values, script guesses, state offsets, or route changes.
scope_residue: This mechanism corrects additive scalar advances. Contextual shaping, ligatures, grapheme clusters, emoji sequences, and font-stack definitions containing multiple comma-separated families are not claimed to be solved by a scalar table and remain separate mechanisms. The checker must distinguish an additive-advance failure from that declared shaping residue.
perturbation_axes: Latin-1 accents versus ASCII base letters
plain versus bold versus italic versus bold-italic
state titles and attributes versus ordinary and self transition labels
precomposed characters versus combining marks as a residue probe
acceptance: Both preserved Unicode counterexamples have exact additive text metrics and are structurally equivalent unless an independently identified out-of-scope residue remains.
Fresh valid additive-script perturbations across all four faces match Java without per-input constants.
The checked-in extractor deterministically regenerates the range table and verifies the original printable-ASCII arrays.
The full renderer library suite passes.
The no-oracle product gate does not regress any family.
A separate checker reviews the exact implementation revision and preserves all passing and failing held-outs.
